purpose: Canonical source-to-document routing for agents and change checks. Code, schemas, registries, and checked runtime data remain authoritative for behavior.
coreRules: Prefer the smallest root-cause fix; avoid unrelated refactors.
Update matching docs for behavior, API, pipeline, methodology, or data-source changes.
Do not replace DefiLlama list supply with manual/on-chain/CMC/DEX overrides; supplemental supply admission paths must be explicit, documented, fail-closed, and double-count safe.
Keep Tailwind classes as static strings.
Do not edit shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/ unless explicitly required.

taskFamilies.label: Stablecoin metadata or registry
docsLikelyRequired: feature methodology docs when behavior changes
hardRules: Keep canonical order, generated data, and schemas aligned.
Commit base coin sources before final sitemap-date generation.
Do not add ad hoc supply overrides outside documented fail-closed admission paths.

taskFamilies.label: Pricing pipeline or source roster
docsLikelyRequired: docs/about-page.md when adding a data source
hardRules: Consume or cancel failed fetch bodies before opening more Worker fetches.
Do not multiply DefiLlama list-endpoint supply by price.

taskFamilies.label: Public or admin API endpoint
checks: npm run test:critical-contracts when endpoint is critical
hardRules: Route flags, auth lane behavior, cache metadata, and site-data allowlists are centralized.

taskFamilies.label: Telegram bot, Mini App, or delivery pipeline
checks: npm run check:telegram-load when delivery capacity changes
hardRules: Preserve signed initData auth and the durable delivery evidence trail.
Do not replace dead-letter and target-state transitions with direct pending-row deletes.

taskFamilies.label: Feedback intake and verification
docsLikelyRequired: docs/api-reference.md when the HTTP contract changes
checks: focused feedback API and verification tests
npm run check:docs-api-reference when the HTTP contract changes
hardRules: Use getCirculatingRaw(); cached DefiLlama circulating values are already USD-denominated.
Feedback verification thresholds follow the shared peg-type depeg policy.

taskFamilies.label: Worker cron or scheduled pipeline
docsLikelyRequired: feature methodology docs when behavior changes
hardRules: Pick the trigger slot before adding fetch-heavy work.
Cron jobs share Cloudflare's per-trigger 6-connection pool.

taskFamilies.label: D1 schema or migration
docsToRead: affected docs/worker-infrastructure.md store/status section when needed
checks: focused API/cron tests for affected stores
hardRules: Migrations must be backward-compatible because CI applies D1 migrations before the new Worker is live.
Destructive cleanup requires a separate coordinated rollout.

taskFamilies.label: Frontend page or route behavior
docsToRead: matched route-specific doc found through docs/doc-ownership.json or rg
checks: npm run seo:check for Pages-impacting route work
hardRules: Static export means route metadata, sitemap, and crawlability can matter even for simple UI changes.

taskFamilies.label: Blog or editorial publishing
docsLikelyRequired: docs/process/blog-publishing.md when the publishing contract changes
checks: npx vitest run src/data/blog src/app/feed src/app/__tests__/sitemap-frozen.test.ts
hardRules: Blog registry and post bodies are source; sitemap dates are derived from committed Git history.

taskFamilies.label: Design or UI polish
docsLikelyRequired: design docs when deployed token/class/component patterns change
checks: browser smoke or screenshot check when layout risk is meaningful
hardRules: Preserve the existing Pharos design language.
Do not edit src/components/ui/ shadcn primitives unless explicitly required.

taskFamilies.label: Methodology or scoring change
hardRules: Methodology versions increase numerically: after v5.9 use v5.91 or v6.0, not v5.10.

taskFamilies.label: Pages Functions or host split
docsToRead: docs/worker-infrastructure.md only when Worker host/auth lane changes
checks: npm run test:smoke-transport when host routing changes
hardRules: Browser reads should use same-origin /_site-data/* unless explicitly exempt.

taskFamilies.label: Validation, CI, or repo policy
checks: npm run check:generated-artifacts when generated-artifact registry or hooks change
npm run check:pr -- --base=<ref> for committed CI-policy batches
hardRules: Keep deploy-surface classification aligned with GitHub deploy behavior.
Commit relevant sources before generating git-history-derived artifacts.

taskFamilies.label: Agent guidance or local hook process
docsLikelyRequired: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md together when top-level guidance changes
checks: npm run check:generated-artifacts -- --only=agents-doc when AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md changes
hardRules: Top-level AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are deliberately kept in sync.
Temporary agent output belongs in ignored scratch locations, not committed docs.

taskFamilies.label: Documentation-only change
checks: npm run check:doc-sync when methodology or generated doc metadata is affected
hardRules: Treat docs/ and README.md as the verified documentation corpus.

mappings.name: stablecoin-metadata
notes: Update methodology docs only when scoring or classification semantics change.

mappings.name: mechanism-explainers
notes: Slug source of truth is MECHANISM_ARCHETYPE_VALUES in shared/types/core.ts. Ordinary content, exact static-param, and sitemap tests enforce explainer completeness; generated artifacts own OG images.

mappings.name: pricing-pipeline
notes: Source roster and live-price selection semantics affect the about page and methodology copy.

mappings.name: api-surface
notes: Route flags, auth lanes, cache profiles, and site-data allowlists should stay in sync with endpoint behavior.

mappings.name: worker-cron
notes: Trigger slots, connection budgets, and status tracking are coupled.

mappings.name: status-and-runbooks
notes: Status causes, recommended actions, public-health floors, and runbooks should be updated together.

mappings.name: d1-migrations
notes: New migrations must be backward-compatible with the standard deploy ordering.

mappings.name: frontend-routes
notes: Use the source path or public route to locate the nearest route-specific contract; the listed docs are representative, not a second route inventory.

mappings.name: editorial-publishing
notes: Registry metadata, post bodies, feed output, banner freshness, sitemap dates, and optional per-post cover/social images form one publishing contract.

mappings.name: design-system
notes: Update design docs when deployed class patterns or tokens change.

mappings.name: feature-flags
notes: NEXT_PUBLIC_PHAROS_* flags are build-time values. Keep workflow env propagation, stale-flag checks, and inlining checks aligned.

mappings.name: methodology
notes: Versioned methodology changes update the structured changelog source; public pages and Markdown exports render from that registry.

mappings.name: mint-authority
notes: Safety Score V9 Economic Control owns the sole published mint score; curated route and posture metadata remain non-scoring review context.

mappings.name: safety-score-v9
notes: V9 is the canonical Safety Score publication. Current consumers fail closed when the accepted publication is unavailable or held.

mappings.name: pages-functions-hosting
notes: Same-origin site-data proxy behavior and internal host lanes are coupled.

mappings.name: validation-and-ci
notes: Keep script inventory and CI descriptions aligned with behavior changes.

mappings.name: telegram-bot
notes: Webhook auth, dispatcher rate-limit handling, secret/token rotation, and the public PharosWatchBot landing share semantics across alerts, runbooks, and incident-response playbooks.

mappings.name: security-surface
notes: Inline script signatures, token-in-URL discipline, host gating, and origin allowlists govern Safe Browsing classifier risk and operator-origin access; update playbooks when touching these surfaces.
